observations: Photo 0 is a promotional/marketing graphic with health-benefit icons (weight loss, blood pressure, etc.) overlaid on an image of a spin bike, not a plain photo of the actual item for sale.
Image carries a 'ROYALSS STORE' watermark and a 'POSTED ON...' stamp, consistent with a stock or template image reused across listings.
Bike shown is black and red with a water bottle in a holder, adjustable seat and handlebars, chain guard, and a flywheel resistance knob.
No brand or model name is legible anywhere on the frame or console.
Background shows a rough outdoor wall and ground, suggesting the photo may have been taken for a different purpose or in a different location than where the actual item now sits.

claims.claim: High-quality Spinning Fitness Bike designed for effective home use
claims.evidence: No close-up of build quality, welds, or materials; image is a marketing graphic.

claims.claim: Improves sleep, energy, blood sugar, immune system, blood pressure, stress, mood, memory
claims.evidence: These are generic health-benefit marketing claims, not claims about this specific unit's condition; cannot be judged from any photo.

risks.risk: The photo may be a stock/template image rather than an actual photo of the seller's unit, so true condition, wear, scratches, or missing parts are unknown.
risks.proof: A plain, unedited photo of the actual bike in the seller's current location, from front, side, and close on the resistance knob and pedals.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified condition, worst case heavily worn or incomplete

risks.risk: No brand or model visible, so original quality tier and spare-parts availability cannot be confirmed.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of any brand sticker, console, or frame decal.

risks.risk: Resistance mechanism, pedals, and seat adjustment function are unverifiable from a graphic image.
risks.proof: A short video clip of someone pedaling and turning the resistance knob.

risks.risk: Frame stability and welds (common failure point on cheap spin bikes) not visible.
risks.proof: Photo of the base/frame joints from a low angle.
risks.if_unproven: priced as structurally unverified, worst case unstable

proof_requests: A real, current photo of the actual bike (not a promotional graphic), full view, no overlays.
Close-up of any brand/model sticker or console screen.
Short video of the bike being pedaled and the resistance knob being turned.
Photo of the frame base and welds from a low angle.
response.reason: The only image supplied is a marketing graphic with health-benefit icons and a watermark, not a genuine photo of the physical item, so even a worst-case condition price cannot be set without an actual photo of the unit.
